    SELECT o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.order_time, st.topping_id, st.topping_name, 'standard' as source
    FROM orders o
    JOIN standard_toppings st ON o.pizza_id = st.pizza_id
    LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON o.row_id = et.row_id AND st.topping_id = et.excluded_topping_id
    WHERE et.excluded_topping_id IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Extra toppings
    SELECT o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.order_time, et2.topping_id, et2.topping_name, 'extra' as source
    FROM orders o
    JOIN extra_toppings et2 ON o.row_id = et2.row_id
)
SELECT * FROM final_toppings ORDER BY row_id, topping_id
